question.text: Which SEBI regulations specifically govern the registration process and conduct of an RTA as an RTA (i.e., the RTA-specific regulations rather than the broader intermediaries framework)?

answer.text: SEBI (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents) Regulations, 1993

explanation.text: The Logic: The RTA-specific registration process and conduct framework is set out in the SEBI (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents) Regulations, 1993 (referenced explicitly on workbook pages 54 and 68). These regulations are the primary source of RTA-specific registration requirements. The Trap: The 2008 Intermediaries Regulations apply to RTAs as one of several SEBI-registered intermediaries, but they are a cross-intermediary framework, not RTA-specific. The 2018 Depositories and Participants Regulations cover DPs, and the 1996 MF Regulations cover mutual funds, not RTAs. The audit flagged the original because workbook page 53 lists the 1993, 2008, and 2018 regulations side-by-side as governing RTAs, so a broad "registered and governed" stem made both the 1993 and 2008 options defensible. Note: The original was ambiguous because of the workbook's plural list of governing regulations on page 53. The stem now asks specifically for the RTA-specific registration regulations (pages 54 and 68 of the NISM Series II-B December 2025 workbook), making "SEBI (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents) Regulations, 1993" uniquely correct.
